steps.en: Install the package and set up the current host
steps.zh: 安装软件包并配置当前宿主

steps.en: Copies the Skill runtime and installs host integration
steps.zh: 复制技能运行时并安装宿主集成

steps.en: Verify the chosen child in the actual project
steps.zh: 在真实项目验证选定的子 agent

steps.en: Give the host a task using AutoSwarm
steps.zh: 把要用 AutoSwarm 处理的任务交给宿主

steps.en: Runs native child calls and returns events and results
steps.zh: 执行原生子调用并交回事件与结果

steps.en: Handle permissions and verify the delivered artifacts
steps.zh: 处理权限请求并验收交回的产物

value.en: Delegate across installed agents without manually moving each native conversation
value.zh: 跨已安装的 agent 委派任务，不再手动搬运每段原生对话
